one_liner: A sunny, sunbathing-obsessed Triple Tiara fangirl who wants to carve a path and pass her dreams on.
personality: Bright, earnest and energetic, she adores the Tiara races and the senpai who ran them, and talks constantly about 'carving open the future' and 'passing the baton' to whoever comes next. She is a dedicated crafter and photographer, a bit of a dreamy bookworm (fantasy novels about demon lords), and easily distracted by a sunny spot to nap in. She is stubborn about what she cares about and gets spooked by bugs and her own over-made jack-o'-lanterns.

story_arc.summary: A Tiara-loving girl who wants to inherit the dreams of past Tiara runners and pass them forward. Her goals include the Hanshin JF, Fillies' Revue, Oka Sho, NHK Mile Cup, Oaks and Shuka Sho, then the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, Victoria Mile, Sprinters S. and Queen Elizabeth II Cup; one branch is titled 'irregular double crown' after the NHK Mile, matching her real-life Oka Sho + NHK Mile wins. Chapter titles like 'Fate of Blood' and 'I Was Here' and a senior-year hospital visit allude to the real horse's early death in 2006.
